The European Union has formally rejected the latest COP31 draft deal, saying it cannot accept an agreement that does not mention fossil fuels.
Darragh O'Brien, the climate and energy minister for Ireland, which holds the rotating EU presidency, said the EU and its member states "object" to the draft because it "does not meet the moment."
"We will not endorse a cover decision, or an Antalya Pact, that does not even mention fossil fuels, which is the key driver of climate change," O'Brien said.
The announcement could see the chaotic and late-running climate talks collapse.
A new COP31 draft agreement had been published early on Sunday as nations continued to struggle to reach an accord.
The new draft kept a much-sought goal to electrify the global economy but again failed to mention fossil fuels, deepening divisions at the UN conference - which is being held in Antalya, Turkey.
The latest text needed consensus approval from almost 200 nations at a closing session on Sunday.
An EU official had told the AFP news agency that the draft was a "backwards" step and warned that there was a "very real possibility" of the talks ending without a deal.
"I am more pessimistic today than I was yesterday," they said.
"The situation is difficult, and the outcome is uncertain. The oil-producing countries are putting up a fierce fight," a German official added.
Planet-heating fossil fuels have become a flashpoint at the talks, which come amid soaring energy prices and simmering global tensions stemming from the Iran war.
A draft deal unveiled earlier this week had called for a sped-up phasing out of fossil fuels. But a second version released on Thursday removed all mentions of the energy sources, forcing negotiators back to the bargaining table.
A group of countries including France and Panama had released a letter on Friday insisting that a deal include "a clear transition away from fossil fuels."
The latest offering acknowledged a previous global deal to transition away from fossil fuels but stopped short of naming them explicitly.
It also kept a contentious push to expand carbon capture and storage, a technology backed by the fossil fuel industry but criticised by opponents as costly and ineffective at reducing emissions.
"We are very disappointed with how the text looks," Michael Joseph, the environment minister of Antigua and Barbuda, told AFP.
"I can't honestly say that I'm okay with it passing" as it is, Joseph said, adding that the draft was "quite silent" on fossil fuels.

A fire at a confectionery factory in Indonesia's Banten province has killed at least three people. Dozens are also unaccounted for after the blaze, which destroyed large parts of the facility.
Indonesian rescue teams are searching for 36 workers who remained unaccounted for after a fire at a candy-making factory killed at least three people, officials said on Sunday.
The fire occurred at the Fonusa Agung Mulia factory, around 50 kilometers (31 miles) west of the capital, Jakarta, in the Serang district of Banten province.
The factory caught fire on Saturday afternoon, local search and rescue agency official Rizky Dwianto said.
"All elements of the joint SAR (search-and-rescue) team are making maximum effort to locate the victims while prioritizing the safety of personnel in the field," he added.
Rizky said four people injured in the blaze had been taken to a nearby hospital and health clinic. Eleven more were said to have been rescued alive.
The governor of Banten province, Andra Soni, told reporters overnight that 60 people were believed to have been inside the factory when the fire broke out.
Drone footage shows the fire destroyed large sections of the three-story building, bringing down the roof in some places.
Survivors said the fire started in a cooling unit on the third floor.
The factory produces Milkita, an Indonesian brand of milk-based candies and snack products.
Indonesia has seen a series of deadly industrial fires in recent years, raising questions about the country's workplace safety standards into question.
Among other disasters, at least 22 people were killed in a fire last December that broke out in a seven-story building in Jakarta after a suspected drone battery explosion, police said.
An explosion in a nickel-processing plant in the east of the country killed at least 13 people in 2023.

EU, UK and some of developing world object to main text that ‘failed to meet the moment’ and did not mention fossil fuels
The EU, the UK and allies in the developing world rejected what they called an unacceptable deal on the future of the climate, which failed even to mention fossil fuels, in a dramatic finish to the Cop31 UN talks in Turkey .
The proposed deal “failed to meet the moment”, said Ireland’s environment minister, Darragh O’Brien, speaking for the EU. “We will not endorse a decision that does not respond to the science and that actually risks deepening the chasm between global commitments and the action required. [It] does not even mention fossil fuels.”
As the talks, scheduled to end on Friday, dragged on into Sunday afternoon it was clear that the “Antalya pact”, drafted by the Turkish and Australian joint presidencies of the summit, would not achieve the consensus needed to pass.
The Antalya pact invites countries to electrify their economies, calls for rich countries to provide finance to the poor to help them adapt to the impacts of the climate crisis, and calls on countries to minimise the “overshoot” of the 1.5C global heating threshold, of the Paris agreement.
But it failed to endorse the “transition away from fossil fuels” that more than 130 countries demanded, and included controversial provisions on “carbon capture and storage” (CCS) technology that campaigners have said perpetuates fossil fuels.
The presidencies avoided outright collapse of the “conference of the parties” by passing decisions on various related matters, including the “just transition” to help workers in high-carbon industries shift to a low-carbon economy.
But Murat Kurum, Turkey’s Cop president, acknowledged there was no agreement on the draft “cover decision” text and so it had not been adopted.
“We have done our utmost; ultimately, we have not imposed this text on anyone, nor have we issued an ultimatum ⁠such as a ‘take it or leave it’ demand,” he said. “It is clear that there are parties in this hall who oppose this text. We recognise ⁠that there is no consensus on this document. Therefore, these decisions have not been adopted.”
Many countries, including the EU, UK and many developing countries including small island states and some of the poorest countries, said they could not support the Antalya pact deal, which was supposed to be the “cover decision”, or main outcome, of the Cop.
In a dramatic intervention, O’Brien said on behalf of the EU that it could not accept the final text in its current form. “It fails to meet the moment … We will not endorse a cover decision or an Antalya pact that does not even mention fossil fuels, which is the key driver of climate change.” He said the EU would not accept a decision “that greenwashes fossil fuels”.
His intervention was met by applause from the hall, and was later followed by similar objections from Panama, the Marshall Islands and Norway.
“This feels like a real line in the sand moment. Countries are standing up to fossil fuel interests and saying no,” said Bill Hare, the chief executive of the advisory group Climate Analytics.
Saudi Arabia defended the decision to include CCS in the text. Other countries, including the Africa group, China and Pakistan, also did not object to the deal, despite some having reservations.
Close to 200 countries have been meeting in Antalya for a fortnight under the joint presidencies of Turkey and Australia, with the overrunning talks marked by long periods of deadlock as countries failed to find common ground.
For many participants, these talks exposed a failure of collective will, particularly of the rich world, to confront the urgency of the climate crisis. Civil society groups, who have a mandated role at the talks, declared it the “worst Cop ever”, while African ministers made a dramatic intervention on Friday saying: “We did not come here to beg.”
Mohamed Adow, the director of the thinktank Power Shift Africa, summed up the view of many on Friday when he said: “The Cop presidents want to tell us this has been a great Cop. Well, I can tell you without any doubt that this has been the worst Cop ever.”
On Sunday, he added: “The EU has rejected this text, but it cannot wash its hands of the wreckage it helped create.... For countries facing failed harvests, destroyed homes and mounting debt, this amounts to abandonment by the wealthy nations most responsible for the crisis.
“Europe’s hypocrisy is staggering. Its governments demand fossil fuel roadmaps from others while expanding fossil fuels themselves.”
While extreme weather around the world has worsened this year, claiming tens of thousands of lives in heatwaves, in disasters such as the glacier collapse in Nepal, and in droughts and floods worsened by the supercharged El Niño , the slow speed of the climate negotiations appalled even veteran participants.
“There isn’t the sense of urgency to address these issues. That to me is very frustrating,” said Mary Robinson, a former president of Ireland and former UN climate envoy, as the talks neared their scheduled close. “We have co-presidents who haven’t really been stepping up and giving that leadership.”

Finland says work is continuing on the Sparta II ship on Sunday
Rescue and firefighting efforts are continuing for a Russian cargo vessel hit by a drone attack in the eastern Gulf of Finland, authorities have said.
The ship - the Sparta II - was bound for Russia's Baltic exclave Kaliningrad when it was hit on Saturday morning, before drifting into Finnish waters. Finnish defence forces said Ukraine was likely behind the attack. Kyiv has yet to comment.
Finland's Border Guard said on Sunday that work was ongoing to make sure the cargo ship did not sink but it was not aware of any danger to surrounding maritime traffic.
Water was still being used to douse the ship on Sunday, and Finland said Estonian and Russian assets were also involved in recovery work.
Kaliningrad Governor Alexei Besprozvannykh said two drones had been used in the strike, based on preliminary information, and there was "no threat" to the territory's supplies.
"War is spilling over into our immediate vicinity," Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said. "Ukraine has the right to fight back against the aggressor."
The Sparta II was sanctioned by the US in 2022 and Ukraine earlier this year, and is run by a Russian company, according to the Ukrainian and US governments.
The company says on its website that it was established within the structure of Russia's defence ministry in 2011 and since 2015 has been operating within the military construction complex.
Finland's coast guard said it had been alerted to the attack at around 08:50 local time (06:50 GMT) on Saturday and that the cargo vessel had been located approximately 50km west of the island of Suursaari in the Gulf of Finland.
This prompted "temporary aviation and maritime restrictions" around the area, Finnish border officials said.
Shortly after the incident, Finland's defence ministry said a Russian helicopter was suspected of violating the country's airspace, potentially linked to "rescue or tracking operations".
A Russian rescue vessel approached the ship and was told by the crew that they did not need to be evacuated, Kaliningrad's governor wrote on Telegram, adding: "The crew is currently carrying out the necessary work and plans to continue on its way."
The Finnish Border Guard later said the crew had been evacuated to another Russian vessel that was now already en route to Russia. The Russian rescue vessel had remained at the location of the stricken ship.
It added that no environmental damage had been detected and that there was no danger to maritime traffic or people.
Kaliningrad is a Russian exclave that sits between Poland and Lithuania.
Defence Minister Antti Häkkänen said that the Finnish Border Guard were responsible for the investigation into the attack and were co-operating with other relevant authorities.
The Baltic Sea has become a flashpoint in the Russia-Ukraine war, triggered when Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Ukraine has recently ramped up its long-range attacks against Russia beyond the front lines.
Earlier this month, a Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland .

Bruno Fernandes speaks exclusively to Sky Sports about his Man Utd future after rejecting two contract offers, insisting he will leave if the club want him to go; watch Liverpool vs Manchester United live on Sky Sports Main Event from 4pm, kick-off at 4.30pm.

Bruno Fernandes exclusively told Sky Sports that Manchester United have offered him a new contract but he has put discussions on hold as he insists the club's priority must be returning to winning ways.
Fernandes has rejected two contract offers from United , Sky Sports News understands, with his current deal due to expire at the end of the season. The club's initial proposal was made in the summer when discussions first began over a new deal, but was turned down by the Portuguese, who signed his last contract in August 2024.
United hold an option to extend the 32-year-old's stay at Old Trafford by a further year, which would also prevent him from speaking to foreign clubs in January over the possibility of a free transfer.
The United captain, who has repeatedly been linked with a move away from Old Trafford, confirmed an offer has been made but dismissed suggestions that negotiations are ongoing or that he has demanded more money or an extended deal.
Fernandes also made clear he would not stand in the club's way if they decided his future lay elsewhere, insisting he has always prioritised United and would not simply stay to run down his contract.
Asked for an update on his contract situation ahead of Manchester United's clash with Liverpool, live on Sky Sports on Super Sunday from 4pm (kick-off at 4.30pm), Fernandes said: "No, there's no negotiations ongoing, but I've seen people saying that he's asked for more money, he's asked for more years. If I wanted more money, I wouldn't be here. I had somewhere to go to get much more money than being at Manchester United.
"I could have been in a place that is much warmer than Manchester.
"Two summers ago, three summers ago, last summer, I always had the chance to leave and I always chose to be here. The thing is, I've always showed how much I care about the club and how much I want to win at this club. And I always said, in the moment the club thinks it's time for me to move on, I will move on.
"I'm not going to be the player that I've seen many in this time at Manchester United. They're going to stay here just by staying, just finish my contract and then we will see. In the moment the club says, 'Bruno, it's time to part ways', I'm going to be the first one walking out the door.
"Yeah, the club offered me a new contract, so I think that, from their side, shows that they want me to stay. And as you said, there are no negotiations going on.
"We spoke about the contract at the end of last season, we came in the beginning of this season speaking about the contract, but about the context of the team and the club, I just put that to a side because I don't think it's the right moment, neither for me, nor for the club, to be talking about negotiations because the most important thing now is that the club gets back to win games."
Fernandes insists his ambitions at United have not changed, despite the club's struggles, and remains determined to bring major honours back to Old Trafford.
"My aim will always be to win the Premier League and the Champions League within the club I am," he said.
The midfielder refused to accept that simply qualifying for the Champions League should become United's primary target. "I will never hide from that, I will never say, no, our position at the moment needs to be to get top four."
Fernandes acknowledged winning the Premier League this season was likely to be beyond United but insisted that was not his expectation when the campaign began.
He also believes supporters have been too patient with the club, recognising their frustration after years without a league title.
Fernandes dismissed suggestions of a breakdown in his relationship with former United boss, Michael Carrick, following his comments during an interview after a 4-1 defeat to Como last month and his subsequent spell on the bench.
The United captain revealed Carrick had personally explained his decision to leave him out against Bournemouth, insisting it had nothing to do with his interview.
"The manager came to speak to me after that game, or before the Bournemouth game, to say, 'look, I'm not going to start you tomorrow' and everything.
"There's nothing to do with the words of Como, I know people will make it around that. I just want to tell you that we need to change something, I need to make a change, performances have not been great, so I just want you to know that there's nothing to do with that," Fernandes said.
He added that he subsequently approached Carrick to clear up any potential misunderstanding, with the manager reassuring him there was no personal issue.
"I told him, 'I think that you probably got our words in the wrong way, and you might be upset with me, and rightly so, if you got it in the way everyone is speaking about it'. And he said, 'Bruno, I'm not; I just put you on the bench because I thought it was the best for the team'."
Fernandes said his return to the starting XI the following game was further evidence that there had been no fallout between the pair.
Fernandes offered a positive early assessment of new United manager Mauricio Pochettino after beginning work with him.
The captain described the new boss as energetic and demanding, revealing Pochettino had already made clear the standards he expects from his players.
"He's someone that likes to bring a very good energy to the team, someone very positive, very strong, strict, said it straight away that he won't allow us to not give him what he demands from the team, from each player," Fernandes said.
"He wants the club to succeed so much, he wants to win games, and that's pretty clear and obvious by the way he and his staff speak and want us to improve."
Fernandes revealed he came close to joining Tottenham in 2019 when Pochettino was in charge at the north London club.
The midfielder confirmed he met with Tottenham's board, who outlined how he could fit into the manager's system, with the prospect of playing alongside Harry Kane, Dele Alli and Heung-Min Son proving attractive.
"Obviously I was a very young player that was eager to come to the Premier League. They had Kane there, they had Dele Alli, Son, the chance of playing with those players in front was very attractive," he said.

Lionel Messi escapes a red-card booking for a controversial throw-in in Miami’s 3-0 defeat to Columbus in MLS Cup playoffs.
Lionel Messi is at the centre of a controversy after hurling the ball at an opponent during a throw-in and after the Columbus Crew coach says the Inter Miami superstar should have been sent off instead of receiving a yellow card.
The incident took place on Saturday during Miami’s 3-0 home defeat by Columbus in the first game of a best-of-three series in the MLS Cup playoffs.
With 10-man Miami 1-0 down at the stroke of half-time, Messi’s frustration boiled over as he aimed a forceful throw-in into the face of Columbus Crew forward Gonzalo Tapia.
Tapia, less than a metre (3ft) away and trying to impede Messi’s actions, threw himself to the ground after the ball hit his face while Messi appealed for a handball.
Referee Allen Chapman showed yellow cards to both Messi and Tapia, but coach Laurent Courtois said afterwards Messi should have been given a red card.
“Everybody knows that he deserved more than a yellow card,” Courtois said in a postgame news conference when asked about the incident.
According to the International Football Association Board Law 12 , which pertains to fouls and misconduct, the appropriate disciplinary action for such an incident would be both players being “cautioned (yellow card) for unsporting behaviour”.
It adds that the player taking the throw-in could be “sent off (red card) for violent conduct (if the thrower used excessive force)”.
Chapman defended his decision to brandish a yellow card to Messi.
“The force used was negligible, and the offence did not reach the level of violent conduct,” the referee told a pool reporter.
Tapia, who scored twice for Columbus in the win, refrained from commenting on the referee’s decision, saying, “I don’t know if it’s a red card, but I am not the referee to say. It stays there.”
Miami head coach Kily Gonzalez also echoed Tapia’s thoughts, adding that the “card doesn’t change much”.
“The referee saw a yellow, and that is it. We can’t blame the referee,” Gonzalez told reporters. “Sometimes they make mistakes. Sometimes they don’t like each one of us, and we have to accept it.”
The 3-0 defeat means seventh-seeded Columbus, the 2023 champions, could eliminate Messi and Miami from the playoffs with a victory in game two of the series in Ohio on Friday.
“It was a game where nothing went right for us, and we effectively created their chances for them,” Gonzalez said.
“We didn’t produce the great performance we had hoped for. Everything went wrong, but we have to learn from it because next time, if we don’t win, we’re out,” he added.

Emergency workers rushed to the scene in Dymer, near Kyiv , where a Russian drone strike had destroyed a section of a five-storey residential building from the first to the fifth floor. Footage released by Ukraine’s State Emergency Service showed rescuers using an extended fire ladder and an aerial platform to help residents escape from the damaged structure, while other teams searched through piles of debris for possible survivors .

In Kharkiv , a strike drone hit the Kyivskyi district and started a fire. In Chernihi v, a Russian strike set a wood-processing plant ablaze, while in Zaporizhzhia three people, including two children, were injured in an evening attack.
The extent of the destruction in Dymer raised fears for residents who might still be beneath the collapsed sections of the building . Rescue workers remained focused on removing debris and reaching potentially trapped people , with no confirmed outcome for those still missing at the time of the initial reports. The ship, bound for the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad, was damaged in international waters before drifting into Finnish territory.
A fire on board a Russian cargo ship that was struck by drones off the coast of Finland in the Baltic Sea continued to burn through the night even as efforts were made to douse the flames, the Finnish coastguard said.
Finland’s military said the strike on the Sparta II on Saturday was likely carried out by Ukraine and that the vessel later drifted into Finnish waters, where it remains at anchor. The 16 crew members were evacuated onto a nearby Russian ship.
Pictures and video released by the coastguard on Sunday showed several vessels spraying the Sparta II with water cannon overnight to put out the flames and cool down containers stacked on its deck.
Ukraine has sent waves of military drones towards Russia’s northwestern coastal region of Leningrad this year, including some that strayed into the airspace of nearby Baltic countries, leading to fears that the war was spilling onto NATO territory.
The ship, bound for the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad, was damaged in international waters west of Russia’s Gogland island, the Finnish Defence Forces said, corroborating an account by Russian officials.
Finland’s Prime Minister Petteri Orpo suggested the incident was related to Russia’s war on Ukraine.
“War is spilling over into our immediate vicinity … Ukraine has the right to fight back against the aggressor,” Orpo said on X.
The risk of further attacks in the Gulf of Finland, a narrow arm of the Baltic Sea, cannot be ruled out, Estonian Navy Commander Ivo Vark told public broadcaster ERR on Sunday.
Finland’s military said last week it had detected a strike on a Russian warship in the same area during Ukrainian drone attacks.
The Sparta II is a 121-metre (397-foot) Russian-flagged cargo vessel owned by Russian shipping company Oboronlogistika that left St Petersburg on Friday, according to data from the London Stock Exchange.
The vessel is subject to US sanctions, according to the US Department of the Treasury.
Oboronlogistika provides logistics services for the Russian Ministry of Defence, according to the company’s website.

Italian jeweller Paolo Bulgari, who helped turn his family's business into a global luxury brand, has died in Rome aged age 89.
His family announced the news, remembering him as "the greatest jeweller of our time", according to Italian media.
Paolo Bulgari was Chairman of the Bvlgari Group since 1984 and its jewellery pieces have adorned Hollywood stars and royalty including Diana, Princess of Wales.
The company Bvlgari posted an online tribute to the "true creative soul", whose work would "continue to inspire generations to come".
The firm, Bulgari, was set up by his grandfather, Greek silversmith Sotirios Voulgaris, in Rome in the late 19th century - who later adapted his name to Bulgari in Italian.
Originally from Paramythia, a mountain village in the Epirus region of northwestern Greece renowned for its silver jewellery, Voulgaris fled Ottoman rule and settled in Naples before opening a shop in Rome.
Paolo Bulgari joined the company shortly after leaving school, becoming an expert in gemstones - eventually leading the business and overseeing international growth.
The Bulgari family favoured bold gemstones, rich yellow gold, generous proportions and unexpected colour combinations to set them apart from the delicate asethetic associated with Parisian jewellery houses.
The business broke into luxury markets and diversified beyond jewellery into watches, perfumes, leather goods and hotels.
"Paolo Bulgari began collaborating with his father in 1960, specialising in the knowledge of precious stones, of which he was one of the world's leading experts, and refining the sensibility and aesthetic sense that are at the root of the Bvlgari style," the Bvlgari company posted on social media. , external
"He poured his heart into his craft and into nurturing the talents of young designers, leaving an indelible mark on the world of jewellery.
"Thank you, Mr. Paolo, your legacy as a brilliant beacon of creative inspiration will continue to inspire generations to come."
Paolo Bulgari alongside David Bowie and his wife Iman in September 1991 in Versailles, France.
The post included a quote from Paolo Bulgari: "Everything can be a source of inspiration. There are no rules in creativity. Never."
The designer brand's celebrity clients have included Elizabeth Taylor, Audrey Hepburn, Marilyn Monroe, Ingrid Bergman, Sophie Loren, Anne Hathaway, Zendaya and Rihanna.
Actor Zendaya wearing a Bvlgari necklace at the 2025 Golden Globe awards.
In 2011 the family sold its controlling stake to the French luxury group LVMH, in a deal worth about 3.7 billion euros.
In 2019, he and his wife established the Paolo Bulgari Foundation to support young people through schooling and job training in disadvantaged neighbourhoods on the outskirts of Rome.
The funeral will take place in Rome on Monday, 23 November in the Basilica of Santa Croce in Gerusalemme.

Protests held on sixth weekend as tens of thousands march over inequality and organisers plan more rallies.
Tens of thousands of people have marched in cities across France for the sixth consecutive weekend to demand better public services and express anger over the rising cost of living and deepening inequality.
The protest movement, sparked in mid-September by high school students calling for improved learning conditions, has since fuelled a nationwide campaign against soaring prices, failing public services and police brutality.
Across the country, organisers reported 150,000 protesters on Saturday, down from 200,000 last week and 800,000 during the first of the weekly demonstrations on October 17.
The Ministry of the Interior said numbers have “significantly declined” as it put Saturday’s turnout at 82,500 people, compared with 106,000 a week earlier.
The protests have been largely peaceful but have seen sporadic violence on the margins and repeated accusations of police brutality.
Last month, huge rallies across France descended into the worst rioting seen in years with hundreds of shops looted and buildings attacked and set on fire.
Unions and activists have called for further protests in the coming weeks.

Kırmızı kartın nasıl çıktığını da anlatan Buruk, hakemle arasında herhangi bir saygısızlık yaşanmadığını savundu. Teknik adam, sahaya girerken hakemlerle tokalaştığını ve kartı arkasını döndüğünde gördüğünü söyledi.

Okan Buruk, kırmızı kartın sebebini maçın ardından hakemle yaptığı görüşmede öğrendiğini belirtti. İçeri girdikten sonra hakemden konuşmak için izin istediğini söyleyen teknik adam, hakemin kendisine kartın gerekçesini anlattığını aktardı.

Futbolda böyle bir kart uygulamasının bulunmadığını savunan Buruk, olayın uluslararası basında da yer bulduğunu belirterek sözlerini şöyle sürdürdü:

Farklı bir şey var, Ali Şansalan da çıkabilir. MHK Başkanı da değerlendirebilir.'
Okan Buruk, kararların kurallar çerçevesinde değerlendirilmesi gerektiğini ifade etti. Haksız bulduğu uygulamanın bir an önce geri alınmasını beklediğini belirten teknik adam, cezayı hak etmesi durumunda bir sorun görmediğini söyledi.
'Kural, kuraldır. Onların dışına çıkamazsınız. Bu yanlış uygulanan kararın bir an önce dönmesini bekliyorum. Önemli olan kuralların uygulanması.'
Buruk, bir camiayı temsil ettiğini de hatırlatarak sözlerini şu ifadelerle tamamladı:
'Ben de bir camiayı temsil ediyorum. Maçın hakemi olabilirsiniz ama ben de Galatasaray 'ın teknik direktörüyüm. Samsunspor'un şikayetçi olduğu konular vardı. Ukrainian rescue teams on Sunday searched for survivors in the rubble of a collapsed residential building in Dymer, in the Kyiv region, after a Russian drone strike, which killed two people and wounded four others. Meanwhile, Finland warned the war was "spilling over" after a drone set fire to a Russian cargo ship in the Baltic Sea Saturday. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.
A rare air alert sounded in Kaliningrad, the Russian exclave near Poland and Lithuania, according to the local governor, as claims circulated online of drone activity near a major naval base there.
The alert late Saturday in Kaliningrad came hours after a drone strike in the Gulf of Finland set fire to a Russian cargo ship bound for the region, which is a key base for Russia's Baltic Fleet. Finnish emergency services were still working to extinguish the blaze on Sunday.
Photos and video posted online show drone activity around the city of Baltiysk, where much of the fleet is stationed. But The Associated Press couldn't immediately verify the authenticity of the images.
According to local media, air raid sirens were heard in Kaliningrad for the first time since Russia’s all-out invasion of Ukraine on Feb. 24, 2022.
The Kaliningrad governor, Alexei Bezprozvannykh, said that “a suspicious object coming from the direction of Lithuania” triggered the alert in the Nemansky district near the Lithuanian border, about 170 kilometers (105 miles) northeast of Baltiysk.
Russia's Defence Ministry said that its forces had shot down 792 Ukrainian drones and four guided bombs in the last 24 hours.
State news agency TASS also cited the ministry as saying Russian forces had captured the settlement of Sosnovy Bor in Ukraine's northeastern Kharkiv region.
A Russian strike on a block of flats north of Kyiv killed one person after causing the building to partially collapse, Ukraine said, warning there could be more victims under the rubble.
An overnight strike on Dymer in the Kyiv region, around 45 kilometres (28 miles) north of the capital, hit a five-storey building, killing at least one person.
"The body of a deceased person was recovered from the rubble ... The search and rescue operation continues. The number of injured has risen to three," Kyiv region governor Tymur Tkachenko said on Telegram.
Schools in Odesa will switch to remote teaching after Russian strikes gravely damaged the energy grid in the major Ukrainian Black Sea port city, the authorities said on Sunday.
Russia has carried out a wide-ranging campaign of strikes against Ukraine's energy infrastructure, with the prospect of another freezing wartime winter looming.
Citing "serious interruptions in heat, electricity and water supply", Odesa's municipal education department decreed a period of home-learning from November 23 to 27.
It advised residents to "charge phones, tablets and laptops as soon as possible so that children can use them to study".
Ukrenergo, the country's energy supplier, warned on Sunday that the electricity situation in and around the city "remains extremely difficult".
"The consequences of the Russian attacks are massive," the company said on social media.
"Russia launched around 2,700 drones, nearly 1,460 aerial bombs, and 165 missiles of various types at them," Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on X.
"A significant number were ballistic missiles, including North Korean ones, which the Russians are constantly helping Pyongyang modernize to improve their accuracy," he continued.
Zelensky urged the US to approve the transfer of Patriot air defence missiles already paid for by Kyiv's partners, saying delays were "difficult to understand".
He also called on allies to continue contributing to the PURL programme, which he described as Ukraine's main source of anti-ballistic interceptors.
Ukraine's restaurant sector employs about 150,000 people and generated about 248 billion hryvnias ($5 billion) in sales last year, according to the National Restaurant Association.
Visitors enjoy their food while chef Anton cooks a meal in a wood-fired oven at a Chornomorka seafood restaurant in Kyiv, Ukraine, on November 14, 2026. © Valentyn Ogirenko, Reuters
During the war, restaurant owners have had to adapt to the difficult circumstances. Generators hum outside kitchens during long blackouts and many restaurants have installed large water tanks to cope with cuts to mains supply. Some have even bought their own water trucks to prepare for long-term disruptions.
Chornomorka, a sea food chain, has developed an "emergency menu" which can be served without running water and electricity, its development director Dmytro Kostrubin said, while some restaurants were prepared to cook some dishes outdoors over an open fire.
But it's getting more difficult to stay in business, especially as annual inflation hit 11% in October and some owners have already exhausted their financial reserves.
"The restaurant business is now in a very difficult situation," said Dmytro Pohrebitskyi, co-owner of the Pesto Cafe chain. "In five years of the war, from my experience, this is the most complicated period in the restaurant business."

Dünyaca ünlü şarkıcı ve oyuncu Jennifer Lopez, yıllardır koruduğu formunun arkasındaki alışkanlıkları paylaştı. Katıldığı Friends Keep Secrets podcast programında beslenme düzeni ve egzersiz programı hakkında konuşan 57 yaşındaki yıldız, özellikle ağırlık çalışmalarının hayatında önemli bir dönüm noktası olduğunu ifade etti.
Eskiden beslenme konusunda kendisini fazla kısıtlamadığını anlatan Lopez, yaş ilerledikçe vücudunun ihtiyaçlarının değiştiğini fark ettiğini söyledi. Ünlü şarkıcı, "Eskiden istediğim her şeyi yiyordum. Ancak biraz yaş aldığımda bunu değiştirmem gerektiğini fark ettim" sözleriyle beslenme alışkanlıklarındaki değişimi anlattı.
Yaşla birlikte kas kaybının önem kazandığını belirten Jennifer Lopez, spor rutinine ağırlık çalışmalarını dahil ettiğini söyledi. Yaklaşık 8-10 yıl önce başladığı bu antrenmanların fiziksel gücünde büyük fark yarattığını dile getiren yıldız, şu ifadeleri kullandı:
"Spor yapıyorum, ağırlık çalışıyorum. Sanırım buna yaklaşık 10 yıl önce, belki de 8-10 yıl önce başladım. Bu benim için gerçekten her şeyi değiştirdi. Kas çalışmak bana güç kazandırdı."
Formunu korumak için yalnızca sporla yetinmeyen Lopez, mutfak alışkanlıklarında da köklü değişikliklere gitti. Geçmişte pirinç, fasulye, ekmek, tereyağı, domuz eti ve kızartma gibi yiyecekleri daha sık tükettiğini belirten şarkıcı, artık protein ağırlıklı bir beslenme düzeni uyguladığını anlattı.
Balık, protein kaynakları ve yeşil sebzeleri öğünlerinde daha fazla tercih ettiğini söyleyen Lopez, "Çok fazla balık yiyorum. Bol protein ve bol yeşillik tüketiyorum" dedi.
Ünlü yıldız, sağlıklı beslenme ve egzersiz alışkanlıklarını başkalarının beklentileri için değil, kendisini daha iyi hissetmek amacıyla sürdürdüğünün de altını çizdi.
Jennifer Lopez'in dikkat çeken alışkanlıklarından biri de kafein tüketmemesi oldu. Günlük yaşamında su içmeye önem verdiğini belirten şarkıcı, kahve dahil kafeinli içeceklerden uzak durduğunu açıkladı. Lopez'in yıllardır sürdürdüğü spor disiplini ve beslenme tercihleri, formunu koruma yöntemlerine ilişkin açıklamalarıyla yeniden gündeme geldi.

Sıla, kostümünü siyah alt parça, gösterişli küpeler ve taş detaylı aksesuarlarla tamamladı. Saçlarını geriye doğru tarayan sanatçı, sahne ışıkları altında dikkat çeken bir görünüm ortaya koydu. Şarkıcının konser sırasında çekilen görüntülerinde hem sahne enerjisi hem de iddialı kıyafet tercihi öne çıktı.
Sahne performansları kadar tarzıyla da ilgi gören Sıla, Cahide Palazzo konserinde sportif fiziğini ön plana çıkaran bir kostüm tercih etti. Ünlü sanatçının karın kaslarını açıkta bırakan kıyafeti, gecenin en dikkat çekici detaylarından biri oldu.

22 Kasım 1940'ta İstanbul'da dünyaya gelen Ediz Hun, 1963 yılında Ses dergisinin düzenlediği yarışmayla sinema dünyasına adım attı. "Genç Kızlar" filmiyle başlayan oyunculuk kariyerinde kısa sürede Yeşilçam'ın sevilen jönlerinden biri haline geldi.
"Acı Hayat", "Samanyolu" ve "Yaprak Dökümü" gibi yapımlarda rol alan usta oyuncu, yıllar boyunca canlandırdığı karakterlerle sinema izleyicisinin hafızasında yer edindi. Sanat hayatının yanı sıra akademik çalışmaları ve çevre konusundaki duyarlılığıyla da öne çıkan Hun, saygınlığını yıllar içinde korudu.
Onlarca film, sayısız başarı ve ödülle dolu bir kariyeri geride bırakan Ediz Hun, 86. yaş gününde sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı paylaşımla hayranlarına seslendi.
Eşiyle birlikte çekilmiş bir fotoğrafını yayımlayan usta sanatçı, kareye "Bugün 86 yıl geride kaldı…" notunu ekledi. Hun'un kısa ama anlamlı mesajı, takipçilerinden çok sayıda beğeni ve yorum aldı. Meslektaşları ve sevenleri, Yeşilçam'ın efsane ismine sağlık, huzur ve nice güzel yaşlar dileyerek doğum gününü kutladı.

Arjantin temsilcisi Boca Juniors , Copa Sudamericana finalinde Brezilya ekibi Atletico Mineiro’yu 2-0 mağlup ederek kupanın sahibi oldu.
Uluslararası arenada 18 yıllık kupa hasretine son veren Arjantin ekibinin şampiyonluk kutlamalarında takımın tecrübeli isimlerinden Leandro Paredes, canlı yayında baygınlık geçirdi.
Kolombiya'nın Barranquilla kentindeki Metropolitano Stadı'nda oynanan finalde Boca Juniors, Atletico Mineiro karşısında sahadan 2-0'lık galibiyetle ayrıldı. Bu sonuçla Arjantin temsilcisi, 2004 ve 2005 yıllarının ardından tarihinde üçüncü kez Copa Sudamericana şampiyonluğuna ulaştı.
Karşılaşmanın ardından şampiyonluk kutlamaları sürerken Boca Juniors'ın Arjantinli futbolcusu Leandro Paredes, verdiği röportaj sırasında aniden fenalaşarak yere yığıldı. Canlı yayına yansıyan olayın ardından sağlık ekipleri futbolcuya müdahalede bulundu.
Boca Juniors Teknik Direktörü Rodolfo Arruabarrena, karşılaşma sırasında da fiziksel sorunlar yaşayan Paredes'in durumuna ilişkin açıklamalarda bulundu. Tecrübeli futbolcunun ilk yarının sonlarına doğru baş dönmesi yaşadığını belirten Arruabarrena, “Soyunma odasına girdiğinde kendisiyle karşılaştım. İlk yarının sonlarına doğru tansiyonu düştü ve baş dönmesi yaşadı. İkinci yarıda 10 dakika boyunca daha iyi durumdaydı ancak sağa sola hareket etmekte zorlandığı görülüyordu. Çok dürüst bir oyuncu, oyundan çıkmak istedi. Tansiyonunun yeniden düştüğünü şimdi öğrendim. Bana iyi olduğu söylendi” ifadelerini kullandı.
Yaşanan olayın ardından hastaneye kaldırılarak kontrolleri yapılan Paredes, sanal medya hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda kendisine gönderilen geçmiş olsun mesajları için teşekkür etti. Arjantinli futbolcu, sağlık durumunun iyi olduğunu belirtti.

TRT 1'de 2023 'te yayınlanan dizide Alize ile Serkan'ı canlandıran ikilinin set arkadaşlığı kısa sürede aşka dönüşmüştü. Çift ilişkisini hiç saklamadı; tatilleri, konserleri ve özel günleri sosyal medyada sık sık gündem oldu.

Peki ünlü çift yollarını ayırdı mı? Şimdilik ne Koçak'tan ne de Tumbar'dan bir açıklama var.

Kastamonu 'nun Taşköprü ilçesine bağlı Ortaöz köyünde 22 yıldır sigara içilmiyor. Köy sakinleri, dışarıdan gelen misafirlerin de sigara yakmasına izin vermiyor.
Köy muhtarı Mahmut Sezer'in öncülüğünde 22 yıl önce başlayan uygulama, Ortaöz ve köye bağlı 3 mahallede ortak kararla sürüyor. 40 haneli köyün girişinde ziyaretçileri 'Sigara içilmeyen Ortaöz köyüne hoş geldiniz' yazılı bir tabela karşılıyor.
Sezer, dışarıdan gelenlerin de kurala uyduğunu anlatarak 'Köye gelenler de bundan memnunlar. Sigara içenler bile tabelaları gördüğü zaman ya da biz söyleyince sigaralarını ceplerine koyuyor' dedi.
Sezer, uygulamayı başlattıklarında herkesin karşı çıktığını söyledi. O dönemi 'Hatta öyle kaçak şekilde içenler oldu ki gelip o levhaların altında kümelenip sigaraları yaktılar' diye anlattı. Bunun üzerine şikâyette bulunduklarını, jandarmanın da konuyla ilgilendiğini ekledi.
Zamanla tepkilerin unutulduğunu belirten Sezer, 'Herkes artık buranın sigara içilmeyen köy olduğunu öğrendi ve alıştı' diye konuştu.
Sezer, kendisinin de 30 yıl sigara içtiğini, sigarayı çalıştığı iş yerindeyken bıraktığını anlattı. En çok yazın köye gelen gençlerle uğraştıklarını söyledi.
Köyde KOAH hastaları olduğunu da hatırlatan Sezer, makineye bağlanıp hava alan hastaların bile makineden çıkar çıkmaz sigara yaktığını anlattı. Sezer, 'Ben devam ettiğim müddetçe bu uygulama böyle devam edecek' ifadelerini kullandı.
Köy sakinlerinden Selfinaz Doğan, 49 yıllık eşi Murat Doğan'ın sigarayı kendisi için bıraktığını anlattı. Doktor , Selfinaz Doğan'ın kanında nikotin bulunduğunu söyleyince eşi kararını vermiş ve 14 Şubat 2004'te sigarayı bırakmış. Doğan, 'Evimiz tertemiz. Hiç duman, is olmuyor' dedi.
Murat Doğan da sigarayı bıraktıktan sonra kendini daha iyi hissettiğini söyledi ve herkese sigarayı bırakmalarını tavsiye etti.

Amerikalı oyuncu Lance Broadway, Dallas'taki bir apartman dairesinin merdiven boşluğunda ölü bulundu. 43 yaşında hayatını kaybeden oyuncunun ölüm nedeninin belirlenebilmesi için otopsi sonucu bekleniyor.
Dallas Polisi, 17 Kasım Salı günü saat 18.40 civarında Broadway'in cansız bedenini bulan bir kişiden gelen acil çağrı üzerine olay yerine gidildiğini açıkladı.
Broadway, önce Major League Baseball'da profesyonel beyzbol oyunculuğu yaptıktan sonra, beyzbol sahasından Hollywood film setlerine geçerek, kamuoyunun önüne birbirinden oldukça farklı iki kariyerle çıktı.
Broadway, 2013 yılında Antoine Fuqua'nın yönettiği ve Gerard Butler'ın yanı sıra Aaron Eckhart ve Morgan Freeman'ın da rol aldığı 'Olympus Has Fallen' filmiyle beyazperdede ilk kez yer aldı. Beyaz Saray'a yapılan bir terör saldırısını konu alan, büyük gişe başarısı yakalayan filmde Broadway, Gizli Servis ajanı O'Neill rolünü üstlendi.
Daha sonra televizyonda kariyer yapan oyuncu, Marvel'ın 'Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.' ve Tom Ellis'in başrolünde olduğu doğaüstü suç draması 'Lucifer' gibi birçok popüler Amerikan dizisinde rol aldı.
Broadway'in diğer televizyon projeleri arasında 'Saint George', 'Kevin From Work' ve 'Real Husbands of Hollywood' yer alıyor.
Broadway, 2013'te verdiği röportajda, 2010 yılında aldığı bir oyunculuk dersinden sonra oyunculuğa yönelmeye karar verdiğini söylemiş, filmdeki ilk deneyimini şöyle anlatmıştı:
"Sanki Major Lig'in soyunma odasına girmiş gibiydim. Orada kendini kanıtlamış, konuşma hakkını kazanmış adamlar vardı ve benim böyle bir hakkım yoktu."
2014 yılında Broadway, genetik olarak tasarlanmış bir mürettebatın uzayda bir kurtarma görevine gönderilmesini konu alan bilim kurgu gerilim filmi 'Teleios'ta Komutan Linden rolünü üstlendi. Film daha sonra 'Beyond the Trek' adıyla 2017'de yeniden gösterime girdi.
Broadway'in televizyondaki son görünümleri arasında, 'Lost' dizisinin oyuncusu Josh Holloway ve 'The Walking Dead' dizisinin oyuncusu Sarah Wayne Callies'in başrollerini paylaştığı distopik bilim kurgu dizisi 'Colony'nin 2016 ve 2017 yılları arasında yayınlanan iki bölümü yer alıyor.

Kastamonu'nun Taşköprü ilçesine bağlı Ortaöz köyünde 22 yıldır sigara içilmiyor. Köy muhtarı Mahmut Sezer'in öncülüğünde 22 yıl önce başlatılan uygulama, Ortaöz köyü ve bağlı 3 mahalledeki vatandaşın ortak mücadelesiyle yıllardır sürdürülüyor. 40 haneli köyün girişinde de ziyaretçileri, "Sigara içilmeyen Ortaöz köyüne hoş geldiniz" tabelası karşılıyor. Köydeki açık ve kapalı alanlarda sigara içilmesine izin vermeyen köy sakinleri, herkese örnek oluyor.
Köy muhtarı Sezer, 22 yıl önce bu uygulamayı başlattıklarında herkesin karşı çıktığını ama daha sonra tüm vatandaşların sigarayı bıraktığını söyledi.
Köyde 22 yıldır sigara içmenin yasak olduğunu belirten Ortaöz köyü muhtarı Mahmut Sezer, "22 yıl önce çok büyük mücadelelerle sigarayla ilgili başlattığımız durumu başarıyla gerçekleştirdik. Tüm komşuların, arkadaşların yardımıyla bunun üstesinden geldik. Köy sınırları içerisinde sadece kapalı alanlarda değil, açık alanlarda da sigara içirtmiyoruz. Köye gelenler de bundan memnunlar. Sigara içenler bile tabelaları gördüğü zaman ya da biz söyleyince sigaralarını ceplerine koyuyor. Herkes zaten duydu, saygı gösteriyorlar" dedi.
İlk zamanlarda uygulamaya bazı vatandaşların tepki gösterdiğini anlatan Sezer, "Çok tepki aldık. Hatta öyle kaçak şekilde içenler oldu ki gelip o levhaların altında kümelenip sigaraları yaktılar. Hemen bunları da haber yaptık. Biz de şikayet ettik. Jandarma bile ilgilendi. Zaman içerisinde bunlar da unutuldu. Her geçen yıl devam ediyoruz. Herhangi bir sıkıntımız yok. Herkes artık buranın sigara içilmeyen köy olduğunu öğrendi ve alıştı" diye konuştu.
Kendisinin de 30 yıl sigara kullandığını belirten Sezer, "Ben 30 yıl sigara içtim. Çalıştığım iş yerinde genel müdür gelir kontrol ederdi. 'Gene mi sigara içiyorsun' diyecek diye aklım çıkardı. Onun için oradayken bırakmıştım. Buraya gelince de aynı mücadeleyi sürdürdük. Yazları çok genç geliyor. Gençlerle çok mücadele veriyoruz" şeklinde konuştu.
Çevre mahallelerde yaşayan vatandaşların da sigarayı bırakabilmek için kendilerinden destek istediklerini anlatan Sezer, "Birlikte bıraktık. Burada KOAH hastaları vardı, makineye bağlı olanlar vardı. Hava almak için makineye bağlanıyor ama çıkar çıkmaz hemen sigarayı yakıyor. Onları da örnek gösterdik. Bu kadar temiz havanın içerisinde sigara içilmesi herkese zarar veriyordu. Çok şükür bundan da kurtuldular. Ben devam ettiğim müddetçe bu uygulama böyle devam edecek. Kimse bizim gözümüzün önünde açıkta sigara içemez. Hangi mahalleme gidersen git, her taraf tertemiz" ifadelerini kullandı.
Köy sakinlerinden Selfinaz Doğan da 49 yıllık eşi Murat Doğan'ın kendisi için sigarayı bıraktığını anlatarak, "Doktor, eşimin sigara içmemesi gerektiğini söyledi. Kanımda nikotin olduğunu öğrenince eşim de bırakmaya karar verdi. 2004 yılında 14 Şubat Sevgililer Günü'nde benim için sigarayı bıraktı. Evimiz tertemiz. Hiç duman, is olmuyor. Allah herkese böyle sigara içilmeyen bir ortam nasip etsin" dedi.
Murat Doğan ise eşi sayesinde sigarayı bıraktığını ve bu durumdan dolayı çok mutlu olduğunu söyledi. Sigarayı bıraktıktan sonra kendisini daha iyi hissetmeye başladığını söyleyen Doğan, herkese sağlıklı bir yaşam için sigarayı bırakmalarını tavsiye etti

Arjantin temsilcisi Boca Juniors , Copa Sudamericana finalinde Brezilya ekibi Atletico Mineiro 'yu 2-0 mağlup ederek kupanın sahibi oldu. Uluslararası arenada 18 yıllık kupa hasretine son veren Arjantin ekibinin şampiyonluk kutlamalarında takımın tecrübeli isimlerinden Leandro Paredes, canlı yayında baygınlık geçirdi.
Kolombiya'nın Barranquilla kentindeki Metropolitano Stadı'nda oynanan finalde Boca Juniors , Atletico Mineiro karşısında sahadan 2-0'lık galibiyetle ayrıldı. Bu sonuçla Arjantin temsilcisi, 2004 ve 2005 yıllarının ardından tarihinde üçüncü kez Copa Sudamericana şampiyonluğuna ulaştı.
Karşılaşmanın ardından şampiyonluk kutlamaları sürerken Boca Juniors'ın Arjantinli futbolcusu Leandro Paredes, verdiği röportaj sırasında aniden fenalaşarak yere yığıldı. Canlı yayına yansıyan olayın ardından sağlık ekipleri futbolcuya müdahalede bulundu.
Boca Juniors Teknik Direktörü Rodolfo Arruabarrena, karşılaşma sırasında da fiziksel sorunlar yaşayan Paredes'in durumuna ilişkin açıklamalarda bulundu. Tecrübeli futbolcunun ilk yarının sonlarına doğru baş dönmesi yaşadığını belirten Arruabarrena, "Soyunma odasına girdiğinde kendisiyle karşılaştım. İlk yarının sonlarına doğru tansiyonu düştü ve baş dönmesi yaşadı. İkinci yarıda 10 dakika boyunca daha iyi durumdaydı ancak sağa sola hareket etmekte zorlandığı görülüyordu. Çok dürüst bir oyuncu, oyundan çıkmak istedi. Tansiyonunun yeniden düştüğünü şimdi öğrendim. Bana iyi olduğu söylendi" ifadelerini kullandı.
Yaşanan olayın ardından hastaneye kaldırılarak kontrolleri yapılan Paredes, sanal medya hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda kendisine gönderilen geçmiş olsun mesajları için teşekkür etti. Arjantinli futbolcu, sağlık durumunun iyi olduğunu belirtti.

US rock musician Marilyn Manson has always strongly denied any allegations against him
A Brent councillor has joined calls to prevent Marilyn Manson performing at Wembley Stadium next year ahead of a trial the singer faces over sexual assault allegations.
Liberal Democrat Anton Georgiou has gathered more than 20,000 signatures on a petition urging the venue to take "a firm stand" against Manson, who is due to support Slipknot there in July.
Manson, whose real name is Brian Warner, is due to stand trial next November in a civil lawsuit brought by his former assistant Ashley Walters, who alleges sexual abuse. He denies the allegation.
Georgiou has written to the promoter Live Nation and Wembley Stadium urging the organisers to cancel the performance until a verdict is reached.
In a statement, Georgiou said: "If Mr Warner is convicted at the upcoming trial, this would reflect extremely badly on the stadium, risk untold reputational damage and send the wrong message to survivors of sexual abuse."
Slipknot fans hit back after Marilyn Manson announced as support act for UK show
More than a dozen charities, who previously called for Manson to be removed from the line-up, have also signed the petition.
Manson has faced multiple allegations of sexual misconduct from several women, some of which have been dropped or dismissed. He denies all the allegations.
Previously, a Brent Council spokesperson said decisions about who performs at Wembley Stadium were "ultimately a matter for the venue and event organisers, rather than Brent Council, which has no direct control over commercial bookings".
"That does not diminish our commitment to tackling violence against women and girls, which has no place in Brent," they added.
"Our commitment to standing up for women and girls is unwavering, and we will continue to demonstrate that through our actions."
The BBC has approached Wembley Stadium and Manson's representatives for comment.

Habertürk' ten Nazif Şahin Karpuz'un haberine göre; Erkan Kolçak Köstendil'in 10 yılı aşkın sürede tamamladığı ve uluslararası festivallerden ödüllerle dönen "Resmin Aklımda Kaldı Izdırap" filminin başarısı özel bir gala gecesiyle kutlandı.
Köstendil’in film ekibi, oyuncu arkadaşları ve dostlarını bir araya getirdiği gecede davetliler, dört kısa filmden oluşan özel yapımı birlikte izledi.
Projenin yaklaşık 10 yıllık bir emeğin ürünü olduğunu belirten Köstendil, "Dört parçadan oluşan, finalde birbirine bağlanan konsept bir deneme. O yüzden paramız oldukça çektik. En başından beri yaklaşık 10 yıl sürdü" dedi. Filmde anlatmak istediği duyguyu paylaşan Köstendil, "Çocukluğumuzdan yaşlılığına kadar birbirimize dokunduğumuz, birbirimize seslendiğimiz ortak hikâyelerimiz, ortak sokaklarımız ve ortak fotoğraflarımız var. Geçmişten bugüne uzanan, belki kendi çocukluğumda hissettiğim şeylerden bugünkü duygularıma kadar uzanan bir yoğunluk var. Aslında çocukluktan yaşlılığa bir yolculuk hissi anlatmak istedim" ifadelerini kullandı.
10 yıllık süreçte hem maddi hem manevi büyük emek verdiği projeyi neden hayata geçirdiği sorulan Köstendil, sinemaya duyduğu sevgiyi şu sözlerle anlattı: Bu meslek bize çok şey verdi. Sinema sayesinde çok şey kazandık, iyi paralar kazandık, tanınırlık kazandık. Bu mesleğe bir şey harcarken insan hiç hissetmiyor. Harcadığım parayı geri alır mıyım, yatırım karşılık bulur mu diye düşünmüyorsunuz. Bu meslek bize çok şey verdi, biz de biraz ona versek ne olur? Bence çok keyifli ve pahalı bir hobi.
Filmin alışılmış vizyon anlayışının dışında bir gösterim yolculuğu olacağını belirten Köstendil, projenin öncelikle sinema salonlarında izleyiciyle buluşacağını, ardından farklı gösterim konseptlerini değerlendirdiklerini söyledi. Daha önce "Tezgâh" filminde de benzer bir yöntem izlediklerini hatırlatan Köstendil, "Vizyona girmeden önce filmi şehir şehir gezdirip açıkhava gösterimleri yaptık. Hep beraber olmak, beraber film izlemek, beraber gülmek ve üzülmek bize iyi geldi. Bunun bizi iyileştirdiğine inanıyoruz. Bu akşam da aslında farklı bir konsepti deniyoruz. Eğer bunun hakkını verebilirsek sinema salonlarına girmeden önce bu konsepti sürdürmek istiyoruz" dedi.
Proje boyunca meslektaşlarından ve dostlarından büyük destek gördüğünü ifade eden Köstendil, yaklaşık 10 yıldır kendisiyle aynı hayali paylaşan arkadaşlarına teşekkür etti: Destekleyenler olmasa bu işin bu aşamaya gelmesi mümkün değildi. Gerçekten çok güzel hayal arkadaşlarım var. Her kısa filmde farklı oyuncular ve ekipler çalıştı ama bir yandan da yaklaşık 10 yıldır bu filmin başından sonuna kadar benimle olan hayal arkadaşlarım var. "Bundan daha büyük bir gelir olamaz herhalde" diye düşünüyorum. Böyle insanların yanınızda olması çok büyük bir kazanç.
Sinema sevgisinin çocukluk yıllarına dayandığını anlatan Köstendil, beyazperdeyle kurduğu bağı, “Çocukken anne annenle, babanla oturup film izlemiş ve onun keyfini almış bir insansan sinema tabii ki aşk” sözleriyle ifade etti.
Filmde yer almaktan dolayı heyecanlı olduğunu belirten Öznur Serçeler, "Erkan’ın çok özenerek hazırladığı bir iş. Biz de onun hayalini gerçekleştirebilmesi için elimizden geleni yapmak istedik. Ben de oldukça heyecanlıyım. Filmi izlemek için sabırsızlanıyorum” dedi.
Oyuncu Cansu Tosun , basın mensuplarının sorularını yanıtladı. Filmde yer alan dört farklı hikâyenin birbirinden ayrı bir ruhu ve tarzı olduğunu belirten Tosun, "Hepsi birbirinden çok güzel. Şimdi bunları bir bütün hâlinde izlemek nasıl olacak, ben de çok merak ediyorum. Oldukça heyecanlıyım" dedi. Filmin hazırlık sürecinde Erkan Kolçak Köstendil’in de büyük bir heyecanla çalıştığını dile getiren Tosun, "Her birini çok keyif alarak, inanarak ve kalpten çekti. Bunu söyleyebilirim" ifadelerini kullandı.
Galaya eski eşi Erkan Kolçak Köstendil’e sürpriz yaparak geldiğini açıklayan Tosun, "Erkan’ın haberi yoktu, söylemedim. Şimdi ben de ona bir sürpriz yaptım. Bakalım, onu da Marsel'i de göreceğim" dedi. Filmde babasının da rol aldığını belirten Tosun, ailesiyle birlikte galada bulunmaktan dolayı mutlu ve heyecanlı olduğunu ifade etti. Galanın kendileri için çok önemli bir gün olduğunu söyleyen oyuncu, filmi izlemek için sabırsızlandıklarını dile getirdi.
Meral Çetinkaya, film ve yönetmeni Erkan Kolçak Köstendil hakkında konuştu. Erkan Kolçak Köstendil’i öğrencilik yıllarından beri tanıdığını belirten Çetinkaya, projede yer alması için kendisine teklif geldiğinde büyük heyecan duyduğunu söyledi. Usta oyuncu, "Erkan’ı çok eskiden, öğrencilik zamanlarından tanıyorum. O şeytan tüyü denilen, insanı etkileyen özelliği o zamanlardan vardı. Böyle bir iş yapacağını öğrenince ve bana teklif edince çok heyecanlandım. Aklında kalmışım, ne güzel, ne mutlu bana" dedi.
Günlerinin hızla geçtiğini söyleyen usta oyuncu, hayat üzerine düşüncelerini de paylaştı. Çetinkaya, "Günler çok hızlı geçiyor. Dünya çok hızlı dönüyor galiba. Artık her şeye geç kalıyorum. Yaşamaya mı, yoksa yaşamak nedir onu çözmeye mi geç kaldım, ikisi birbirine karışıyor. Ama bu yaşa gelince ‘şükür’ kelimesini daha çok sever oldum. Bugünkü günümü aramayalım. Kimse de bugününü aratmasın. Çünkü dünya şu sıralar hiç de güzel bir geleceğe gitmiyor" diye konuştu.
Dizi ve sinema sektörünü de değerlendiren Meral Çetinkaya, yeni jenerasyonun oldukça yetenekli olduğunu ancak çalışma koşullarının zorlaştığını dile getirdi: Yeni jenerasyonda çok yetenekli oyuncular ve meslek insanları var. Eskisinden çok daha fazla düşünüyor, daha geniş ve ayrıntılı bakıyorlar. Ama olanaklar konusunda sıkıntılar var. Herkesin yolu açık olsun. Herkese sabır ve bereket diliyorum. Çünkü ben ortamı pek iyi görmüyorum.

texts.https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cry8:
Joseph Langdon was supported by the Bristol Old Vic while in a young offenders' institution
A former young offender who became a West End actor says taking drama lessons while he was detained was the best decision he ever made.
Joseph Langdon, who grew up in south London, was convicted of gang-related crimes at the the age of 16. But while in a young offenders' institution, he was offered drama lessons through a scheme with the Bristol Old Vic.
Langdon said the lessons taught him "that I could make something of my life, and introduced me to this world I did not think was possible".
The actor, who will play the prince in the theatre's Christmas production of Cinderella: A Fairytale, said: "I count my blessings every day. I turn up to rehearsals with a huge smile on my face."
"I'm now working all over the world and have the most amazing life," he added.
"When I think of old friends from when I was a kid – some are dead now, some are in prison and I know that would be my life if it wasn't for Bristol Old Vic giving me a chance and hope."
While in a young offenders' institution in Bristol, he was taught drama every week through a scheme run by the Bristol Old Vic Young Company.
"At first I was like, 'No I'm not going to go, I feel a bit too cool for this'.
"But when I did decide to go it was the best decision I ever made. I never skipped a lesson," he said.
At the end of his sentence, Langdon was told he could either move back to London and "get caught up in the same trouble" or move to Bristol "and start life afresh".
The cast of Cinderella have been rehearsing at the Bristol Old Vic
Langdon moved to Bristol, where he lived in youth hostels and halfway houses while training at the Old Vic through the Made in Bristol scheme - a free programme for young theatre makers.
He said coming out of prison was tough, but his support network kept him "on track".
The actor also worked at the theatre's box office and took part in various productions before returning to south London to study at Mountview drama school, thanks to a bursary scheme.
He said he was anxious about going back to the area he grew up in but "everybody was so supportive and proud".
After graduating, Langdon went on to act in numerous films and productions, including in the West End.
"Being adopted by Bristol has been the biggest blessing of my life," said Langdon, who returns to the city to star in Cinderella.
"The Bristol Old Vic has such a special, special, magical energy" and it is "truly an honour and a blessing to be part of that," said the actor.
Lucy Hunt, Bristol Old Vic's director of engagement, said Langdon understood "first-hand how a bit of belief in a young person can make a big impact on their lives".
"I am so happy he is back," said Hunt. "He is the best positive energy to have around and he's going to be amazing as the prince."
The Olivier Award-nominated adaptation of Cinderella was devised by Bristol artists Sally Cookson, Adam Peck and the Original Company and draws from various versions of the fairytale, including the Brothers Grimm story.
"Ultimately, it's a beautiful family show full of fun, magic and wonder," said Langdon.
Langdon now goes into schools and gives talks to "be that representation" for those interested in theatre.
He says he wants to "show other people from all different backgrounds, no matter who you are, that this is possible".
Cinderella: A Fairytale runs at the Bristol Old Vic from 27 November to 2 January.

texts.https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6jr:
A portrait of Daphne du Maurier sent to Fernande, her French finishing school tutor in August 1930
A set of photos of globally renowned 20th century author Daphne du Maurier has been shared by her family for the first time.
The photos show du Maurier in a series of family images, in settings including around Cornwall where she lived and did most of her writing - she died in 1989.
Her eldest grandson Paul de Zulueta found the pictures while researching a new book telling the personal story of his grandmother's artistic dynasty.
He said: "They were all tucked away in my mother's box. She said you might find this amusing - there's a box of photos here."
Du Maurier's novels which include Rebecca, Frenchman's Creek and Jamaica Inn continue to enthral readers, and often make the dark and brooding Cornish landscape central to the story.
Rebecca, written in 1938, has sold about 30 million copies worldwide and several of her novels have been made into TV shows and films.
Her grandson says writing about his ancestors and his famous grandmother has helped him understand her better.
One of the photos shows Paul's grandparents Daphne and Tommy outside Ferryside, around the time of their honeymoon in 1932
De Zulueta was given access to du Maurier's private letters and photos, kept by his mother and his aunt.
His book Last Night I Dreamt tells of her connection to Ferryside, on the banks of the river Fowey in Cornwall, which has been a du Maurier family home for 100 years.
She first stayed there when she was 19, and it is where she wrote her first novel, The Loving Spirit.
Bodinnick, near Fowey, is also where she met her husband, Lt Gen Sir Frederick Browning, affectionately known as Tommy within the family.
When asked to pick two of the photos, De Zulueta referred to one showing the couple walking arm in arm not long after they married, and another of them in a boat.
"This is a particularly nice photograph of Daphne and Tommy in Fowey. Tommy my grandfather was wearing his brown leather jerkin.
"And of course this one is taken just outside of Ferryside in 1932. It must have been around the time of their honeymoon more or less, as they got married in July1932.
Paul De Zulueta recently returned to Fowey to talk about the du Maurier family history at the town's literary festival
De Zueleta visited his grandmother in Fowey as a child every school holiday.
He remembers her being great fun, very mischievous and "someone with a great sense of humour, who filled a room with laughter", rather than the reclusive figure she is often described as.
"And she said when she first came down to Cornwall 'this is the freedom that I have long sought.
"The freedom to write and the freedom to walk, the freedom to be by myself'."
She later moved to Menabilly, the house that was the inspiration for Manderley, the country estate in Rebecca.
Daphne and Tommy out together in Cornwall in early autumn 1933
Daphne (right), Tod (left, the family's housekeeper and governess) and the author's two children Flavia and Kits (standing) basking in the sun outside the east wing of Menabilly in 1952
Rediscovering his grandparents' relationship from the perspective of an adult has been a voyage of discovery for De Zulueta, who now believes his grandfather had Post Traumatic Stress Disorder after the war, for the rest of his life.
Browning's wartime service culminated in commanding airborne forces in the flawed Operation Market Garden, where thousands of troops parachuted into the Netherlands trying to seize key bridges from the Germans.
De Zulueta now recognises the stress his grandfather's absence would have had on the couple and the pressures of war meant "we need to judge the era softly".
He said: "They [Tommy and Daphne] had a very loving, deep relationship but it was unsettled at times.
"My grandmother was bisexual and she did also have an affair in 1942."
"I think Daphne regretted that affair, the family have never admitted to it, but I discovered a letter," he added.
Her grandson said reading her correspondence meant he had "got to like her a lot more".
"I always felt Daphne neglected him and therefore I was always in my grandfather's camp, but the more I read more about her life, I began to admire and respect her a great deal more.
"She was a great writer and how could she possibly be up in London trying to write books with my grandfather."
"She had to be in Cornwall because that was the ground-swell of her imagination," he added.
